CustomField.description: Sum of CurrentMrr across every active Asset (LifecycleStartDate on or before today, LifecycleEndDate blank or on/after today) linked to this Contract via AssetContractRelationship. Maintained nightly by ContractNightlyRollupBatch — Asset is not master-detail to Contract, so no declarative Roll-Up Summary is possible, and CurrentMrr can change purely from the calendar crossing an AssetStatePeriod boundary with no record write to trigger off of.
CustomField.label: MRR
